entities.summary: Shokei Matsui (b. 1963-01-15, Bunkyō-ku) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bunkyō-ku and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, architects & designers, asia.
